modules.name: Authentication
modules.purpose: Handles user login, token issuance, OTP-based password change, session management, and logout
features: RS256 JWT access tokens (15-min TTL)
Opaque refresh tokens stored in Redis (7-day TTL)
Argon2id password hashing (memoryCost:65536, timeCost:3, parallelism:4)
6-digit OTP via email for password change (10-min TTL)
Account lockout after 5 failed attempts with email alert to user and SUPER_ADMIN
Midnight cron flush of all refresh tokens
Session tracking in PostgreSQL sessions table
Multi-session management with per-session revocation
Force password change on first login
pgcrypto field-level decryption of email on login

modules.name: Authorization / RBAC
modules.purpose: Enforces role-based access control across all 19 roles on both server and client
features: 19 distinct roles: SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, DOCTOR, NURSE, RECEPTIONIST, LAB_TECH, PHARMACIST, INVENTORY, RADIOLOGIST, BILLING, HR, DIETITIAN, PHYSIO, ANESTHETIST, SOCIAL_WORKER, IT_ADMIN, SECURITY_OFC, ORDERLY, PATIENT
JWT payload carries roles array
authorize() middleware factory checks roles on every protected route
Ownership middleware for PATIENT role — prevents cross-patient data access
Client-side RequireAuth component with role-based route guards
Role-based home page redirect

modules.name: Audit Logging
modules.purpose: Tamper-evident hash-chain audit log for all system actions
features: SHA-256 hash chain: each row stores prev_hash and row_hash
PostgreSQL advisory lock ensures serialized writes
Auto-logs every HTTP request via Express middleware
Manual auditLog() calls in all service layers
Flagging system: admins can flag suspicious entries with reason
Hash chain verification endpoint
Filterable audit log viewer for admins
Stores: userId, action, entity, entityId, prevData, nextData, IP, userAgent

modules.name: Security Middleware
modules.purpose: Defense-in-depth middleware stack applied to all API routes
features: Helmet.js with strict CSP (defaultSrc self, no unsafe-eval)
CORS restricted to CLIENT_ORIGIN env var
Double-submit CSRF protection (csrf-csrf library) with __Host- cookie prefix in production
Redis sliding-window rate limiter: 200 req/min global, 20 req/15min auth, 5 login attempts/15min
IP blocking: admin-managed blocked_ips table with Redis cache
Input sanitization: strips null bytes and control characters from all request bodies
Zod schema validation on all routes
Request ID header (X-Request-Id) on every response
2MB body size limit

modules.name: Encryption
modules.purpose: Multi-layer encryption strategy for data at rest and in transit
features: Client-side AES-256-GCM file encryption using Web Crypto API before upload
PBKDF2-SHA256 key derivation (310,000 iterations per OWASP 2023)
pgcrypto pgp_sym_encrypt for PII fields: email, phone, address, emergency_contact, diagnosis, notes
AES-256-GCM encrypted messages stored in DB (content + encryption_iv columns)
AES-256-GCM encrypted notifications (title + body + encryption_iv)
JWT tokens wrapped in AES-256-GCM in sessionStorage
File integrity: SHA-256 checksum stored per file
ClamAV virus scan on upload (graceful skip if not installed)
MIME type validation via magic bytes (file-type library)

modules.name: Telemedicine
modules.purpose: Secure video consultation between doctors and patients
features: WebRTC peer-to-peer video/audio via RTCPeerConnection
Socket.io /telemedicine namespace for signaling
HMAC-SHA256 room tokens (timing-safe comparison)
Participant validation: only doctor and patient of the session can join
Time-window enforcement: 5 min early entry, 30 min grace after scheduled end
Polite/impolite peer model for offer collision handling
Screen sharing via getDisplayMedia
In-call encrypted chat (ciphertext relayed, never logged)
Consultation note saved to medical_records on session end
BullMQ reminder jobs 15 min before session
Session status lifecycle: WAITING -> ACTIVE -> COMPLETED

modules.name: Messaging
modules.purpose: Encrypted real-time group and direct messaging for hospital staff
features: AES-256-GCM end-to-end encrypted messages (ciphertext stored, never inspected server-side)
Per-group shared AES-256-GCM key stored in message_group_keys table
Redis pub/sub for multi-instance fan-out
Group types: DIRECT, GROUP, DEPARTMENT, BROADCAST
Typing indicators with 3-second auto-clear
Message reactions (emoji)
Delete for everyone (within 5 min) or delete for me
Read receipts and unread counts
Online presence tracking via Redis
Patients excluded from messaging (staff-only)
Auto-join department group on user creation

modules.name: Notifications
modules.purpose: Real-time in-app and browser push notifications
features: Socket.io /notifications namespace with JWT auth
Web Push (VAPID) for browser push notifications
Encrypted notification content (AES-256-GCM title+body)
21 notification types including VITALS_CRITICAL, DRUG_INTERACTION_WARN, EMERGENCY_ALERT
Unread count badge
Mark read / mark all read
Push subscription management with 410 Gone cleanup

modules.name: Patient Management
modules.purpose: Patient registration, profile management, and medical timeline
features: MRN (Medical Record Number) generation
PII encryption: email, phone, address, emergency_contact via pgcrypto
Soft delete pattern (deleted_at column)
Patient portal access via linked user account
Medical timeline view
Ownership enforcement for patient self-access

modules.name: Clinical Modules
modules.purpose: Core clinical workflow: vitals, prescriptions, lab orders, discharge, case notes
features: Vitals recording with physiological range constraints
Drug interaction checker (12 known interactions, 4 severity levels)
Allergy cross-check against prescription items
Lab order lifecycle: PENDING -> COLLECTED -> PROCESSING -> COMPLETED
Discharge summary with linked medical records
Nurse handover notes
Dietitian diet plans
Case notes per patient

modules.name: Inventory & Bed Management
modules.purpose: Hospital inventory tracking, bed management, and QR code asset tracking
features: Inventory items with reorder level alerts
Bed matrix with real-time status (AVAILABLE/OCCUPIED/MAINTENANCE/RESERVED)
QR code generation and scanning for asset tracking
Blood bank unit management with expiry tracking
6 inventory categories: MEDICINE, EQUIPMENT, CONSUMABLE, LINEN, CHEMICAL, OTHER

modules.name: Billing & Payments
modules.purpose: Patient billing, insurance claims, and Razorpay payment integration
features: Bill lifecycle: DRAFT -> ISSUED -> PARTIALLY_PAID -> PAID -> CANCELLED -> REFUNDED
Insurance policy linking and claim tracking
Razorpay payment gateway integration (test mode)
PDF bill generation via Puppeteer
Discount approval workflow

modules.name: HR & Workforce
modules.purpose: Staff scheduling, leave management, and payroll
features: Shift scheduling with conflict detection
7 leave types: ANNUAL, SICK, MATERNITY, PATERNITY, UNPAID, EMERGENCY, COMPENSATORY
Leave balance tracking per year
Leave approval workflow
Payroll schema (migration defined, service stub)

modules.name: Admin Dashboard
modules.purpose: System administration: user management, audit logs, analytics, IP blocking
features: User CRUD with role assignment
Force logout any session
IP blocking with expiry and Redis cache
Audit log viewer with hash chain verification
Stats dashboard with Redis caching
Broadcast compose for role-targeted announcements
Department management

modules.name: AI Chatbot
modules.purpose: AI-powered patient assistant for appointment booking and general queries
features: Multi-provider LLM: Google Gemini, Ollama (local)
Intent detection via keyword patterns before LLM call
Patient context grounding (appointments, prescriptions)
Automated appointment booking from chat
Receptionist handoff with notification
Rate limiting: 20 messages/hour per user via Redis
Conversation history in Redis (2-hour TTL)
Medical disclaimer enforcement
Safety filters (Gemini HARM_CATEGORY blocks)
Fallback replies when LLM unavailable

modules.name: PWA & Offline
modules.purpose: Progressive Web App with offline resilience
features: Workbox service worker with precaching
CacheFirst for static assets (7-day expiry)
NetworkFirst for API calls (8-second timeout)
Background sync for failed POST /vitals (IndexedDB queue)
Web Push notification support
Install prompt for home screen addition
4 cache namespaces: static, api, fonts, images

modules.name: Analytics & Reports
modules.purpose: Hospital analytics and async PDF/CSV report generation
features: Patient admission trends
Financial revenue analytics
Staff performance metrics
BullMQ async report generation (PDF via Puppeteer, CSV, JSON)
Report job status polling
1-hour download window via Redis
Report history in PostgreSQL

architecture_type: Monorepo full-stack SPA with modular Express backend, PostgreSQL primary store, Redis cache/queue, Socket.io real-time layer, BullMQ async job processing, PWA frontend
real_time_features: Socket.io WebSocket with JWT authentication on all namespaces
/messaging namespace: encrypted group chat with Redis pub/sub fan-out
offline_capabilities: Workbox service worker with 4 cache strategies
Background sync for POST /vitals when offline (IndexedDB queue)
NetworkFirst API caching with 8-second timeout fallback
known_limitations: Group message keys stored plaintext server-side (noted in migration 010 comment: not zero-trust)
Telemedicine chat sends ciphertext but IV is empty string in TeleRoom.jsx (incomplete E2E encryption)
ClamAV virus scan is optional/graceful-skip (not enforced)
Payroll module is schema-only (no service or routes implemented)
SMS notification worker is a stub (TODO comment in queue.js)
Drug interaction database is hardcoded (12 entries) — not a clinical API
File encryption keys stored in sessionStorage (noted as needing proper KMS in production)
STUN servers are public Google servers (no TURN server configured for NAT traversal)
Default password hardcoded in admin.service.js createUser()
Redis group key cache uses Math.random() for key generation (not crypto.getRandomValues)
